title: Hazardous 2ft Craters & Exposed Rebar at Hill Road Main Junction
description: Multiple deep potholes and craters with exposed aggregate and broken sub-base right where Hill Road merges into the central junction. Heavy monsoon runoff has eroded the asphalt layer, causing daily traffic bottlenecks. Two-wheelers frequently swerve into oncoming lanes during peak morning rush.

title: Severe Stormwater Backflow & Knee-Deep Inundation outside Hill Road Temple
description: The entire 200-meter stretch of Hill Road adjacent to the temple is submerged under 18 inches of stagnant stormwater following yesterday evening's torrential rain. The roadside storm culverts are choked with plastic debris, stranding pedestrians and stalling auto-rickshaws.

title: High-Voltage Distribution Cable Sagging & Sparking near Shivaji Market Gate 2
description: An overhead 415V distribution line has snapped off its insulator bracket and is hanging less than 6 feet above the pedestrian walkway near Shivaji Market Gate 2. Sparks were observed during wind gusts, creating severe risk for market shoppers and school children.

title: Blackout from 4 Inoperative LED Streetlights along Gandhi Park Perimeter
description: Four consecutive municipal LED streetlights starting from the Gandhi Park entrance gate to the community hall corner have been unlit for 4 consecutive nights. The lack of illumination creates safety hazards for evening walkers and women returning from the transit terminal.

title: Unattended Solid Waste Accumulation & Open Dump at Market Road Corner
description: More than 3 tons of unsorted municipal solid waste and wet commercial food refuse has been piling up on Market Road corner due to missed collection cycles. Stray animals are scattering garbage across the roadway, generating foul odors and health concerns for neighboring grocery vendors.

title: Ruptured Underground Sewage Line Discharging onto Gully Lane Pavement
description: A fractured 300mm underground sewer line caused raw wastewater to bubble up through stormwater chambers across Gully Lane. Ward sanitation team performed high-pressure suction and clearing; community verification is currently open to validate that the flow has permanently ceased.
resolution_notes: High-pressure jetting and de-silting completed by ward sewer maintenance team; manhole chamber resealed and sanitized.

title: High-Pressure Potable Water Main Rupture at Nagar Road Crossing
description: A burst municipal feeder pipeline at the Nagar Road intersection was discharging clean drinking water under pressure, flooding the road and reducing household water pressure across Sectors 3 and 4. Emergency valve replacement and tar resurfacing successfully resolved the issue.
resolution_notes: Leaking collar coupling replaced with reinforced ductile iron sleeve; road surface repaved with hot mix bitumen. Verified by 3 ward citizens.

title: Extensive Bitumen Degradation & Loose Gravel in Front of Z.P. School
description: The access road directly fronting Z.P. Primary School has suffered severe surface breakup with loose gravel and sharp stone clusters spread across both lanes. School vans and bicycles lose traction, presenting an immediate safety risk for over 400 young students.

title: Transformer Feeder Fault Causing Complete Darkness on Sector 4 Service Road
description: A feeder line short circuit has knocked out power to 12 overhead sodium vapor lamps along the 500-meter Sector 4 service road. The total darkness has prompted multiple civic complaints regarding pedestrian security and vehicle collisions at unlit intersections.

title: Unanchored Low-Hanging Telecommunication & Power Cables at City Bus Terminal
description: Tangled bunches of overhead telecom fibers and electrical service drops have sagged to a height of 5.5 feet directly at the City Bus Terminal passenger boarding platform. While an initial inspection claimed clearance, commuters dispute the fix as cables still obstruct double-decker bus clearance.
resolution_notes: Contractor claims service cables were re-bundled and secured to high steel brackets.

title: Illegal Night Dumping of Concrete Demolition Slag on Ring Road Green Belt
description: Multiple commercial dump trucks deposited uncrushed reinforced concrete blocks, plaster rubble, and rebar scraps onto the vacant civic reservation plot off Ring Road. Airborne silica dust and obstruction of drainage swales require municipal anti-encroachment intervention.

title: Uncovered 3ft Storm Drain Chamber on Main Station Approach Road
description: A cast-iron manhole cover over an active 10-foot deep stormwater collection pit on Station Road near the old post office was dislodged and stolen. Local shop owners placed tree branches as a makeshift warning to prevent fatal falls during heavy pedestrian traffic.

title: Derelict Commercial Van Obstructing Emergency Vehicle Access in Ward 45 Lane 3
description: A rusted commercial transport van with deflated tires and broken windows has been abandoned for over 45 days in Lane 3, narrowing the right-of-way and preventing fire tenders or ambulances from entering residential apartment complexes.

title: Unattended Cattle Herd Creating Severe Collision Risk at Shivaji Chowk Roundabout
description: A herd of 15 to 20 stray cattle regularly occupies the central lanes of Shivaji Chowk Roundabout between 6 PM and 10 PM. Multiple near-miss accidents and emergency braking incidents have occurred on the high-speed arterial corridor.

title: Disrupted Municipal Water Tanker Schedule in Urban Central Zone 2
description: Scheduled daily municipal water tanker distribution was interrupted for 72 consecutive hours in Urban Central Zone 2 due to depot logistics failure, affecting over 1,200 households. The ward water department re-routed two dedicated 10,000-liter tankers to restore regular supply.
resolution_notes: Two dedicated 10KL potable tankers dispatched on morning and evening shifts; supply quota normalized.

title: Dangerous Shoulder Erosion & Subgrade Embankment Collapse near Bridge Culvert
description: Monsoon floodwaters washed away 15 meters of earthen embankment shoulder adjacent to the bridge culvert on Outer Ward Link Road. The municipal engineering team erected steel guardrails and temporary sandbag reinforcement; community review is ongoing for citizen sign-off.
resolution_notes: Heavy-duty sandbag embankment stabilization and retroreflective caution barriers installed by highway maintenance division.

title: Persistent Missed Door-to-Door Wet & Dry Waste Segregation Collection
description: Contracted municipal waste collection vehicles failed to service residential lanes 4 through 8 for two consecutive pickup days. Segregated bins are overflowing onto residential verges, causing severe neighborhood hygiene issues.

title: Shattered Reinforced Concrete Commuter Bench at Central Bus Shelter
description: Vandalism and structural fatigue caused the cast concrete seating slab at the Central Bus Shelter to crack and collapse. Senior citizens and persons with disabilities are left with nowhere to sit during transit wait times.

title: Fraudulent Lottery Prize Voucher Posters Pasted Across Public Notice Boards
description: Deceptive promotional flyers promising fake cash lottery disbursements with malicious QR codes were repeatedly plastered over municipal civic notice boards. Marked for administrative removal and reporter flagged.
